title: Austin Debates Holly Power Plant
summary:
*   A special meeting was held specifically to discuss issues related to the Holly Power Plant.
*   The community discussion, taking place at Metz Elementary School, lasted for three hours.
*   Despite the extensive dialogue, no formal actions or policy decisions were made during the meeting.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
FEBRUARY 9,1999-6:30 P.M.
METZ ELEMENTARY SCHOOL
The meeting was called to order by Mayor Pro Tern Goodman, noting the absence of Mayor
Watson.
1.
The purpose of the meeting is to discuss issues related to the Holly Power Plant.
Discussion held, no action was taken.
ADJOURNED at 9:30 P.M.
These minutes were approved on February 17,2000 on Mayor Pro Tern Goodman's motion,
Council Member Garcia's second on a 5-0 vote. Council Member Lewis and Spelman were off
the dais.
